channel_type.description:
Use 'public' for access by all project members. Use 'private' for access by channel members only. Defaults to 'public'. This endpoint cannot create personal #me spaces.

* `public` - public
* `private` - private

member_ids.description: User IDs to add to a private channel. The requester is always a member. The endpoint ignores this field for public channels and skips users without project access.

name.description: Channel name, shown as #<name>. Uses lowercase letters and hyphens.

star.description: Star a new channel for the requester. This field does not change stars on an existing channel.
